plugin.name: Remote Client
plugin.description: Use on a player connecting to the Skyrim Together host. No IP entry is required: TradeTogether reads STR's last connected server address automatically and uses that host on UDP port 27993. The client normally needs no port forwarding.

plugin.name: Remote Host
plugin.description: Use on the host PC. Forward UDP port 27993 on the router to this PC and allow UDP 27993 through Windows Firewall. TradeTogether learns each client's NAT endpoint from the automatic handshake.
